h: חַג הַפֶּסַח, מַאֲמָר י״ב Pesach — Maamar Yud Bais
Re-establish the City with Dew: The Crown in Hashem's Hand and the Dew of Atika

p: קוֹמֵם עִיר בָּהּ חֶפְצְךָ בַּטָּל, שִׂימָה בְּיָדְךָ עֲטֶרֶת בַּטָּל.
"Re-establish the city in which is Your desire, with dew; place in Your hand a crown, with dew."
הֵם לְשׁוֹנוֹת בַּפָּסוּק, אַךְ מַה טִיבָם וְשַׁיָּיכוּת לַטַּל?
These are expressions drawn from Scripture, yet what is their nature and connection to dew?
עֲטֶרֶת — כֶּתֶר עֶלְיוֹן, טַלָּא דְּעַתִּיקָא.
"A crown" refers to Kesser Elyon, the Dew of Atika (Tala d'Atika).
וְאִיתָא
And it is stated
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק א' ר"ב.)
(Zohar, Vol. 1, 202a)
דְּהָא לֵית לָךְ מִלָּה לְתַבְּרָא יֵצֶר הָרָע אֶלָּא אוֹרַיְיתָא,
that there is nothing capable of breaking the evil inclination except Torah
וְהַיְינוּ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה, שֶׁהוּא הָ"רֹב חָכְמָה" שֶׁבָּא לְתַקֵּן הָ"רֹב כַּעַס".
meaning the Oral Torah, which is the "abundance of wisdom" that comes to rectify the "abundance of anger."
וְכֵן הוּא לְשׁוֹן הַגְּמָרָא
And such is the wording of the Gemara
(סוּכָּה נ"ב:):
(Sukkah 52b):
אִם פָּגַע בְּךָ מְנוּוָּל זֶה מָשְׁכֵהוּ לְבֵית הַמִּדְרָשׁ
"If this repulsive one encounters you, drag him to the study hall"
שֶׁהוּא מְקוֹם חִידּוּשׁ הֲלָכוֹת,
which is the place where halachic insights are innovated,
וּמַיְיתֵי מִדִּכְתִיב
and it cites as proof what is written
(יִרְמְיָה כ"ג, כ"ט):
(Yirmiyahu 23:29):
הֲלוֹא כֹה דְבָרִי כָּאֵשׁ וְגוֹמֵר
"Is not My word like fire, etc."
דְּבַר ה' זוֹ הֲלָכָה
"the word of Hashem—this is halachah"
(שַׁבָּת קל"ח:).
(Shabbos 138b).
וְזֶה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר
And this is what is said
(יְשַׁעְיָה ס"ב, א'):
(Yeshayahu 62:1):
לְמַעַן צִיּוֹן לֹא אֶחֱשֶׁה וְגוֹמֵר עַד יֵצֵא כַנֹּגַהּ צִדְקָהּ
"For Zion's sake I will not be silent, etc., until her righteousness goes forth like radiance"
שֶׁאוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם מְקַטְרְגִים: מַה נִּשְׁתַּנּוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁבָּחַר בָּהֶם ה'?
for the nations of the world prosecute, asking: "How are Israel different that Hashem chose them?"
וְה' יִתְבָּרַךְ יְבָרֵר: וְעַמֵּךְ כֻּלָּם צַדִּיקִים.
And Hashem, may He be blessed, will clarify: "And your people are all righteous."
וְזֶה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: עַד יֵצֵא כַנֹּגַהּ צִדְקָהּ וְגוֹמֵר וְרָאוּ גוֹיִם צִדְקֵךְ וְגוֹמֵר,
And this is what is meant by "until her righteousness goes forth like radiance, etc., and the nations shall see your righteousness, etc."
שֶׁלֹּא יְקַטְרְגוּ עוֹד.
so that they will prosecute no longer.
וְהוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ
And this follows what they said
(סַנְהֶדְרִין צ"ז:):
(Sanhedrin 97b):
שֶׁמָּא תֹּאמַר אָנוּ מְחַכִּין וְהוּא אֵינוֹ מְחַכֶּה?
"Lest you say, 'We are waiting, and He is not waiting'?
תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר: לָכֵן יְחַכֶּה ה' לַחֲנַנְכֶם וְגוֹמֵר.
Scripture states: 'Therefore Hashem waits to be gracious to you, etc.'
וְכִי מֵאַחַר שֶׁאָנוּ מְחַכִּים וְהוּא מְחַכֶּה, מִי מְעַכֵּב?
Since we are waiting and He is waiting, who is delaying it?
מִדַּת הַדִּין מְעַכֶּבֶת.
The Attribute of Strict Judgment is delaying it."
וְזֶה שֶׁאוֹמְרִים מִקּוֹדֶם: קוֹמֵם עִיר בָּהּ חֶפְצְךָ,
And this is why we say earlier in the piyut: "Re-establish the city in which is Your desire,"
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר
along the lines of what is said
(יְשַׁעְיָה ס"ב, ד'):
(Yeshayahu 62:4):
כִּי לָךְ יִקָּרֵא חֶפְצִי בָהּ וּלְאַרְצֵךְ בְּעוּלָה.
"For you shall be called Cheftzi-Bah (My desire is in her), and your land Be'ulah (Espoused)."
וּבַמִּדְרָשׁ
And in the Midrash
(בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פ', ז')
(Bereishis Rabbah 80:7)
לָמַדְנוּ מִפָּרָשָׁה שֶׁל אוֹתוֹ רָשָׁע: כִּי חָפֵץ בְּבַת יַעֲקֹב
we learned from the section of that wicked man (Shechem), "because he desired (chafeitz) Yaakov's daughter,"
בְּשָׁלֹשׁ לְשׁוֹנוֹת שֶׁל חִיבָּה חִיבֵּב הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל:
that with three expressions of endearment did the Holy One, blessed is He, endear Israel:
בִּדְבִיקָה, בַּחֲשִׁיקָה, בַּחֲפִיצָה וְכוּלֵּי.
with cleaving, with longing, and with desiring, etc.
וְאָמַר: קוֹמֵם עִיר בָּהּ חֶפְצְךָ בַּטָּל,
And the poet says: "Re-establish the city in which is Your desire, with dew"
הַיְינוּ טַל תּוֹרָה, טַלָּא דְּעַתִּיקָא
meaning the dew of Torah, the Dew of Atika
(וְנִתְבָּאֵר כַּמָּה פְּעָמִים),
(as explained many times),
וְהַיְינוּ תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה שֶׁהִיא בְּגָלוּת,
which is the Oral Torah that is in exile,
שֶׁכֵּן עִיקַּר הִתְפַּשְּׁטוּת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה הָיָה בְּבָבֶל
for indeed the primary dissemination of the Oral Torah was in Babylon
(Sukkah 20a),
וְכֵן בְּכָל הָאוּמּוֹת הָעוֹלָם יֵשׁ אֶצְלָם בְּגָלוּת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה, וְזֶהוּ "בַּטָּל".
and likewise among all the nations of the world, the Oral Torah is in exile with them—and this is "with dew."
וְאַחַר כָּךְ אָמַר: עִיר כְּסוּכָּה נוֹתֶרֶת,
And afterward he says: "a city left like a booth,"
מִלְּשׁוֹן הַכָּתוּב
from the wording of the verse
(Yeshayahu 1:8):
וְנוֹתְרָה בַת צִיּוֹן כְּסֻכָּה בְכָרֶם,
"And the daughter of Zion is left like a booth in a vineyard,"
וּפֵירֵשׁ רַשִׁ"י דְּסוּכַּת הַכֶּרֶם גָּר שָׁם יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה;
and Rashi explained that the watchman of the vineyard booth dwells there day and night;
וּכְתִיב
and it is written
כִּי כֶרֶם ה' צְבָאוֹת בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל,
"For the vineyard of Hashem of Hosts is the House of Israel,"
וְכֵיוָן שֶׁגָּלוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל נוֹתְרָה בַת צִיּוֹן כְּסוּכָּה בְכָרֶם.
and once Israel were exiled, the daughter of Zion was left like a booth in a vineyard.
שִׂימָה בְּיָדְךָ עֲטֶרֶת
"Place in Your hand a crown"
וּמַה טִיבָהּ שֶׁל עֲטֶרֶת בְּיָד?!
now what business does a crown have in the hand?!
וּבַפָּסוּק גַּם כֵּן כְּתִיב
And in the verse it is also written
וְהָיִיתְ עֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת בְּיַד ה' וּצְנִיף מְלוּכָה בְּכַף אֱלֹהָיִךְ וְגוֹמֵר;
"And you shall be a crown of splendor in the hand of Hashem, and a royal diadem in the palm of your God, etc."
וְהִנֵּה עֲטֶרֶת וּפְאֵר גַּם כֵּן עַל הָרֹאשׁ,
yet a crown and splendor belong on the head,
וְכֵן צָנִיף, וּכְמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר
and so too a diadem, as it is said
(זְכַרְיָה ג', ה'):
(Zechariah 3:5):
יָשִׂימוּ צָנִיף טָהוֹר עַל רֹאשׁוֹ
"Let them place a pure diadem upon his head"
וּמַה שַׁיָּיכוּת זֶה לְיָד?!
so what connection has this to the hand?!
וְהִנֵּה מִצַּד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם שֶׁהָיְתָה מִטָּתוֹ שְׁלֵימָה, אֵין פְּסוֹלֶת כְּלָל,
Now, from the side of our father Yaakov, peace be upon him, whose bed was complete, there is no dross whatsoever,
וּמִצִּדּוֹ כְּבָר תִּיקֵּן כָּל פְּגַם הַנָּחָשׁ וּפָסְקָה זוּהֲמָא מֵאֲבוֹתֵינוּ
and from his perspective he already rectified the entire blemish of the serpent, and the filth ceased from our forefathers
(שַׁבָּת קמ"ו.),
(Shabbos 146a),
וְכֵן בֶּאֱמֶת יַעֲקֹב לֹא מֵת
and so in truth Yaakov did not die
(תַּעֲנִית ה':).
(Taanis 5b).
וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מִתְפָּאֵר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל:
And the Holy One, blessed is He, glories in Israel:
תְּפִילִּין דְּמָארֵי עָלְמָא מַה כְּתִיב בְּהוּ? וּמִי כְּעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגוֹמֵר
"What is written in the Tefillin of the Master of the Universe? 'And who is like Your people Israel, etc.'"
(בְּרָכוֹת ו'.).
(Berachos 6a).
וְהִנֵּה כָּל הָאָבוֹת אַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק נִקְרְאוּ גַּם כֵּן יִשְׂרָאֵל
Now all the Patriarchs—Avraham and Yitzchak—were also called Israel
(בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה ס"ג, ג'),
(Bereishis Rabbah 63:3),
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁגַּם מִטָּתָם שְׁלֵימָה, דְּעֵשָׂו וְיִשְׁמָעֵאל לֹא נֶחְשְׁבוּ לְזַרְעָם, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ
meaning that their beds too were complete, for Esav and Yishmael were not reckoned as their offspring, as they said
(נְדָרִים ל"א.):
(Nedarim 31a):
"בְּיִצְחָק" — וְלֹא כָּל יִצְחָק.
"'In Yitzchak [shall your seed be called]'—and not all of Yitzchak."
אַךְ כָּל זְמַן שֶׁלֹּא נוֹלַד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ, לֹא נִקְרְאוּ אַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק יִשְׂרָאֵל, שֶׁיָּצָא מֵהֶם פְּסוֹלֶת;
However, as long as our father Yaakov had not yet been born, Avraham and Yitzchak were not called Israel, because dross emerged from them;
וְלִהְיוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל מְבוֹרָרִים גַּם מִצַּד אַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק, זֶה יִהְיֶה לֶעָתִיד.
and for Israel to be refined and clarified from the aspect of Avraham and Yitzchak as well—that will happen in the future.
וְזֶה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וְהָיִיתְ עֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת בְּיַד ה' וּצְנִיף מְלוּכָה בְּכַף אֱלֹהָיִךְ.
And this is what is meant by "And you shall be a crown of splendor in the hand of Hashem, and a royal diadem in the palm of your God."
הַיְינוּ דְּאַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק הֵם מֶרְכָּבָה לְמִדּוֹת חֶסֶד וּגְבוּרָה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר
That is, Avraham and Yitzchak are chariots for the attributes of Chessed and Gevurah, as it is said
(מִיכָה ז', כ'):
(Michah 7:20):
חֶסֶד לְאַבְרָהָם,
"Kindness to Avraham,"
וּפַחַד יִצְחָק
and "the Fear of Yitzchak"
(בְּרֵאשִׁית ל"א, מ"ב),
(Bereishis 31:42),
וְהֵם מְכוּנִּים
and they are called
(בְּפֶתַח אֵלִיָּהוּ):
(in Patach Eliyahu):
חֶסֶד דְּרוֹעָא יְמִינָא, גְּבוּרָה דְּרוֹעָא שְׂמָאלָא.
"Chessed is the right arm, Gevurah is the left arm."
וְאָמַר הַכָּתוּב: תִּפְאֶרֶת וּמְלוּכָה
And Scripture says "splendor (Tiferes) and royalty (Meluchah)"
תִּפְאֶרֶת וּמַלְכוּת, קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא וּשְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ.
Tiferes and Malchus, the Holy One, blessed is He, and His Shechinah.
וְהוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁמּוּבָא
And this is based on what is brought
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק א' רי"ט.):
(Zohar, Vol. 1, 219a):
בַּת יָהֲבָה לְאַבְרָהָם וְכוּלֵּי
"He gave a daughter to Avraham, etc."
בַּת הָיְתָה לְאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ וּבַכֹּל שְׁמָהּ;
our father Avraham had a daughter and Bakol was her name;
יִצְחָק אִיתָא
and regarding Yitzchak it is stated
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג' פ':):
(Zohar, Vol. 3, 80b):
אוֹרַיְיתָא מִסִּטְרָא דִּגְבוּרָה קָא אַתְיָא
"The Torah comes from the side of Gevurah,"
קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא תּוֹרָה אִיקְרֵי
and "the Holy One, blessed is He, is called Torah"
וְזֶה שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: עֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת בְּיַד ה'
And this is what is said: "a crown of splendor in the hand of Hashem"
יָד שְׂמֹאל,
the left hand [Gevurah],
וּצְנִיף מְלוּכָה בְּכַף אֱלֹהָיִךְ
and "a royal diadem in the palm of your God"
גְּבוּרָה דְּרוֹעָא שְׂמָאלָא [וְחֶסֶד דְּרוֹעָא יְמִינָא].
Gevurah, the left arm [and Chessed, the right arm].
וְזֶה שֶׁאוֹמְרִים: שִׂימָה בְּיָדְךָ עֲטֶרֶת בַּטָּל
And this is what we say: "Place in Your hand a crown, with dew"
עַל יְדֵי תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה שֶׁהוּא מִטַּלָּא דְּעַתִּיקָא.
through the Oral Torah, which stems from the Dew of Atika.
וּבַפָּסוּק: לֹא יֵאָמֵר לָךְ עוֹד עֲזוּבָה וּלְאַרְצֵךְ לֹא יֵאָמֵר עוֹד שְׁמָמָה
And in the verse: "It shall no longer be said to you 'Forsaken,' and to your land it shall no longer be said 'Desolate'"
כְּסוּכָּה בְכָרֶם
like a booth in a vineyard

This is what the poet composed: ‘Dew, grant it to favor Your land’—that the Shechinah, the lower Heh, should be united and joined with the letters Yud-Heh-Vav, whose filling with Alefs equals tal. ‘Re-establish the city in which is Your desire, with dew’: through the dew the Holy One, blessed is He, will raise up the holy city, which is the secret of raising the Shechinah from the dust.” Connection: The Apter Rav also reads “Re-establish the city … with dew” as the Dew of Atika that revives the dead and raises Knesses Yisrael; Rav Tzadok identifies that dew with the Oral Torah in exile.

paragraphs.text: Parallel: Pri Tzaddik, Balak 12 — “Yaakov comprises the love of Avraham and Yitzchak, and Avraham and Yitzchak were included in Yaakov’s holiness, for Avraham is called Israel and Yitzchak is called Israel. ‘Israel’ indicates that his bed is complete, without dross. Once Yaakov was born, Avraham was clarified, ‘for in Yitzchak shall your seed be called,’ and Yishmael is not counted Avraham’s seed; and Yitzchak was clarified, ‘in Yitzchak and not all of Yitzchak,’ Esav excluded. But this was only after Yaakov was born; before that there was dross in their seed, for Yishmael was included in Avraham’s seed… and Esav in Yitzchak’s. Therefore at the third Shabbos meal we mention all three Patriarchs.” Connection: The same claim that Avraham and Yitzchak become “Israel” only through Yaakov, applied to the third Shabbos meal and the Shabbos Minchah prayer.
